# auramix.com.au

Static build of the AuraMix marketing site, served by GitHub Pages at
**https://auramix.com.au**. A [Calibre Squad](https://calibresquad.com.au) product.

**Do not edit files here by hand.** Source lives in the `auramix-site`
Next.js repo. To deploy: `npm run build` there, then copy `out/` into this
repo and push.
